result.scope: Unnamed per-day candidate diagnostics. No tracked current/eddy register, runtime, release, state geometry or index modified.

method.closure: ContourPy SeparateCode CLOSEPOLY plus identical first/last coordinates; never snap or bridge.
method.missing_data: corner_mask=False; reject any missing grid-point interior and any domain-clipped contour.
method.orientation: Positive signed spherical area retains high-interior contours; low-interior loops excluded.
method.mean: Finite ocean gridpoints within longitude -99..-80 and latitude 17..31; arithmetic primary, cosine latitude weighting diagnostic alternative.
method.sensitivity: Independent 0.15/0.17/0.19 m contours for each of two means. IDs are local to each date/scenario, never a cross-scenario or temporal identity.
method.metric_scope: Enclosed spherical contour area, planar area-equivalent diameter, geographic bounding arcs and perimeter. Bounding arcs are not along-flow length, minimum width or principal axes.

interpretation: Neither source-map date supplies a uniquely selected eligible closed loop at all six scenarios. No gridded sizes admitted. The 4000 km2 screen is review eligibility, not evidence that no smaller feature exists. Date/control-point/product/boundary mismatches remain unresolved. Operational chart spans below are a separate method, not replacement gridded values.
